::: {.callout-note}
This page is being written. The headings below show what it will cover, with links to the parts of the analysis plan that govern each section.
:::

This page will explain, in plain language and without code, what this study chose and why. The general background it relies on is on [Methodological background](methodological_background.qmd). The formal specification is the [analysis plan](analysis-plan.qmd). Three kinds of note mark where the description stands:

- **Specified in:** the section of the analysis plan that defines the method.
- **Current code:** where the code does not yet do what the plan says, what it does now, with a link to the GitHub issue tracking the difference.
- **Decision pending:** a choice the plan has not yet made, linked to its decision issue. A paragraph that starts with **Decision pending:** is highlighted in yellow automatically.

## The question and the design in brief

*Will cover:* the question, the matched cohort design, and what is estimated.

**Specified in:** [§1 Objective](analysis-plan.qmd#1-objective), [§2 Design](analysis-plan.qmd#2-design).

**Decision pending:** whether the comparison with liver-only recipients with HIV is part of this paper ([#19](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/19)).

## Data and study period

*Will cover:* the SRTR release and the transplant years included.

**Specified in:** [§3 Data source](analysis-plan.qmd#3-data-source).

## Who is included

*Will cover:* how SLK recipients are identified, and who is excluded and why.

**Specified in:** [§4 Study population](analysis-plan.qmd#4-study-population).

**Decision pending:** the recipient age threshold ([#11](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/11)).

## HIV status, era and time zero

*Will cover:* how HIV status is classified from the two files, the pre- and post-DAA eras, and when follow-up starts.

**Specified in:** [§5 Exposure, era, and time zero](analysis-plan.qmd#5-exposure-era-and-time-zero).

**Decision pending:** HIV status when one file is positive and the other unknown ([#12](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/12)).

## Matching

*Will cover:* how HIV-negative controls are matched to each HIV-positive recipient, and how balance is checked.

**Specified in:** [§6 Matching](analysis-plan.qmd#6-matching).

**Decision pending:** the propensity score covariates, including recipient race ([#13](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/13)), and missing continuous covariates ([#14](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/14)).

## Outcomes

*Will cover:* all-cause mortality, death-censored kidney and liver graft failure, and hospital length of stay.

**Specified in:** [§7 Outcomes](analysis-plan.qmd#7-outcomes).

**Decision pending:** whether retransplantation or return to dialysis counts as graft failure ([#15](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/15)).

## Analysis

*Will cover:* the descriptive comparisons, survival curves, Cox models, effect modification by era, and length of stay.

**Specified in:** [§8 Statistical analysis](analysis-plan.qmd#8-statistical-analysis).

**Decision pending:** regression for length of stay ([#16](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/16)), adjusted era-specific models ([#17](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/17)), and sparse or zero events ([#20](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/20)).

**Specified in:** [§9 Sensitivity analyses](analysis-plan.qmd#9-sensitivity-analyses).

*Will cover:* how counts are protected before anything is published.

**Specified in:** [§10 Disclosure control](analysis-plan.qmd#10-disclosure-control).

**Decision pending:** the small-cell rule under the SRTR data use agreement ([#18](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/issues/18)).
